# Agent flags

Every command-line flag of the agent (the binary built from cmd/enforcer/main.go), with its type, default and description. Generated from the binary's --help output.

<!-- generated by `make docs-reference`; do not edit -->

The agent reads its configuration from flags only; it has no environment variable equivalents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cluster-name` | string |  | Name of this cluster in the Protem fleet (required) |
| `--hub-context` | string |  | Override kubectl context to connect to hub cluster |
| `--hub-kubeconfig` | string |  | Path to hub kubeconfig (defaults to standard kubeconfig) |
| `--hub-token-secret` | string |  | <namespace>/<name> of a Secret on the target cluster that stores the renewed hub token (empty: memory only) |
| `--hub-token-ttl` | duration | `24h0m0s` | Lifetime of each hub token the agent requests; it renews after a third of it (minimum 10m) |
| `--kubeconfig` | string |  | Paths to a kubeconfig. Only required if out-of-cluster. |
| `--subject-template` | string | `"{{.Email}}"` | Template for mapping user to RBAC subject |
| `--sync-interval` | duration | `3s` | Polling and sync interval with Hub |
| `--target-context` | string |  | Override kubectl context to connect to the target cluster |
| `--target-kubeconfig` | string |  | Path to target cluster kubeconfig (defaults to standard kubeconfig) |
| `--zap-devel` | bool | `true` | Development Mode defaults(encoder=consoleEncoder,logLevel=Debug,stackTraceLevel=Warn). Production Mode defaults(encoder=jsonEncoder,logLevel=Info,stackTraceLevel=Error) |
| `--zap-encoder` | value |  | Zap log encoding (one of 'json' or 'console') |
| `--zap-log-level` | value |  | Zap Level to configure the verbosity of logging. Can be one of 'debug', 'info', 'error', 'panic'or any integer value > 0 which corresponds to custom debug levels of increasing verbosity |
| `--zap-stacktrace-level` | value |  | Zap Level at and above which stacktraces are captured (one of 'info', 'error', 'panic'). |
| `--zap-time-encoding` | value |  | Zap time encoding (one of 'epoch', 'millis', 'nano', 'iso8601', 'rfc3339' or 'rfc3339nano'). Defaults to 'epoch'. |
